submission.justification: Absorber-F1 at 6 mm provides the best simulated energy resolution at 100 GeV (3.28%) among all candidate materials and thicknesses, satisfying the primary performance goal. All project constraints are met: the material is an approved candidate, thickness is within limits, mechanical and maintenance compatibility is confirmed, and all options support the required readout. This choice is supported by both the latest simulations and prior results.

requirements.requirement: The absorber must be one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: Absorber-F1 is listed in candidate_specs.md as a valid option.

requirements.requirement: The calorimeter must allow hands-on maintenance during shutdowns.
requirements.evidence: Meeting notes confirm the mechanical support design, including maintenance, is compatible with Absorber-F1.
The selected thickness, 6 mm, is within the permitted range.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Simulations demonstrate that Absorber-F1 at 6 mm gives the lowest energy resolution (3.28%) among all tested configurations.
